amazon-10590820.body:
This is a contractual role for 12 Months
Join our Finance Operations team to ensure accurate invoice processing and maintain the financial integrity of our accounts payable operations. You'll work with our ERP system to match invoices, resolve discrepancies, and support our vendor payment processes while maintaining high accuracy standards.
Key job responsibilities
Match invoices from the ERP system to supporting documentation and resolve discrepancies to maintain accuracy standards above 98%
Research and process credits, returns, and payment holds to ensure proper accounting treatment
Prepare vendor statements and reconciliations to support vendor relationships and financial reporting
Perform quality checks on processed invoices to verify accuracy and compliance with established procedures
Meet established productivity targets while maintaining quality standards
A day in the life
As a FinOps Analyst in our Accounts Payable team, you'll focus on invoice matching within our ERP system, working to resolve variances between vendor invoices and our internal records. Your day includes reviewing matched invoices for quality assurance, researching credits and returns to ensure accurate accounting, investigating payment holds, and preparing vendor statements. You'll collaborate with our finance team to address complex matching issues and contribute to our shared services environment where efficiency and accuracy are equally valued. This role offers the opportunity to develop expertise in financial operations while supporting the broader finance function across our organization.
About the team
We are a collaborative Finance Operations team dedicated to maintaining accurate and efficient accounts payable processes. Our team serves internal stakeholders and external vendors by ensuring timely and accurate payment processing. We're focused on building a reliable financial foundation that supports our organization's growth, and we value team members who bring attention to detail and a commitment to continuous improvement. You'll work alongside colleagues who are invested in supporting one another and maintaining the highest standards of financial accuracy.
- Bachelor's degree or equivalent in a related field
- 1+ years of Accounts Payable (AP) experience
- Knowledge of Microsoft Office Suite (Excel, Word, SharePoint, and PowerPoint)
- Experience in accounts receivable or account payable, or experience with documenting accounting conclusions
- Bachelor's degree or equivalent

This Financial Analyst position is based in Bangalore. 
Key job responsibilities
Key responsibilities:
Finance Analyst will be a finance partner to the relevant business team. This includes, among other things, responsibility for financial metrics, reporting, forecasting and analysis. The successful candidate will be strategic, analytical, and have the demonstrated ability to effectively manage finances of a high-growth business:
 Perform financial reporting and support monthly P&L analysis and Financial forecasts.
 Support in monthly/quarterly financial closing activity in close co-ordination with business and accounting teams
 Closely monitor and control opex budget for the business. Evaluate and question the opex requirements and continuously benchmark cost productivity for the business.
 Facilitate financial review meetings with business groups and work with business managers to ensure effective finance and cost management.
 Assist in Measuring and reporting progress on key goals for the business team in a timely manner
 Measuring and monitoring of metrics for new business initiatives
 Provide inputs for monthly and quarterly business reviews in a timely manner. Facilitate the business reviews with data analysis and follow through with business leaders on actionable items for improving business metrics over a period of time.
 Perform ad-hoc business analyses, and financial modeling. Present recommendations to senior management on strategic decisions, and planned future initiatives.

unstop-1793055.body:
About Us: 
 Founded in 2014, Vedantu emerged as a visionary in the ed-tech space, pioneering the shift towards online education in India. Our name, derived from 'Veda' (knowledge) and 'Tantu' (network), reflects our mission: to create a vast network of knowledge accessible to all. We embarked on a journey to transform the educational landscape, leveraging technology to make quality education available, affordable, and personalized.
 Our Leaders: 
 Vedantu`s founders Vamsi Krishna, Anand Prakash, and Pulkit Jain did their first venture in education, Lakshya, in 2006 which later got acquired by a listed company called MT Educare (Mahesh Tutorials) in 2012. As part of Lakshya, the founders taught and mentored more than 10,000 students and trained more than 200 teachers between them.
 Vamsi Krishna - Co-Founder and CEO
 Pulkit Jain - Co-Founder and Head of Product
 Anand Prakash - Co-Founder and Head of Academics
 Arnab Dutta - COO
 Pankaj Jain - CFO
 Simriti Goel - Head of HR
 Working Days: 6 days a week
 Tuesday to Sunday
 Working Hours: 11:00 AM – 8:00 PM.
 Location: Bangalore.
 Summary of the Role: 
 We are looking for highly motivated, energetic, and result-oriented Direct Sales Associates to join our high-growth EdTech sales team in Bengaluru and Chennai. In this role, you will be the face of the company, directly interacting with parents and students to understand their educational gaps and pitch our premium learning solutions.This is a hardcore direct role requiring a blend of persistent tele-calling, virtual counseling and field consulting to meet monthly revenue milestones.
 Responsibilities: 
 Lead Conversion: Initiate outbound connections with potential leads generated through marketing campaigns via cold calls, emails, and WhatsApp.
 Educational Counseling: Act as an academic consultant by identifying the specific learning needs of students, mapping them to our courses, and conducting impactful product demonstrations.
 End-to-End Sales Closure: Manage the complete sales pipeline from first contact, overcoming customer objections, to final payment collection and onboarding.
 Target Achievement: Consistently achieve individual daily talk-time metrics and monthly gross revenue targets.
 Relationship Building: Build a strong rapport with parents and prospective buyers to foster long-term customer trust and generate organic referrals
 Required Skills and Qualifications: 
 Experience: 0 to 2 years of proven experience in hardcore inside sales, direct sales, or business development. Experience in EdTech, BFSI, Telecom, or high-velocity B2C sales is a major advantage.
 Education: Any Graduate or Postgraduate degree.
 Communication: Exceptional verbal and written communication skills in English.
 Proficiency in local languages (Kannada for Bengaluru) is highly desirable to build a local connection.
 Mindset: High resilience, target-driven attitude, and ability to handle intense market rejection.
 Logistics: Willingness to work on a rotational roster, including weekends (Saturdays & Sundays are critical business days in EdTech)
 What’s in it for You? 
 Uncapped Incentives: Direct correlation between your hard work and earning potential with best-in-industry monthly incentive structures.
 Fast-Track Growth: Performance-linked promotions enabling top performers to step up into Team Lead or Sales Manager roles within 12–18 months.
 Comprehensive Training: Robust 1 week sales boot camp covering product knowledge, consumer psychology, and consultative selling frameworks.

 College or university students aged 18 and above.

 Experience building a startup community from the ground up.
 Exposure to AI-powered business tools and entrepreneurship.
 Practical networking and communication skills.

Roles 
 • Run go-to-market for three live AI products — NoteSathi, Geet and TurtleReel — on
  your own campus for two months.
• About 5–6 hours a week, work from home. The only in-person part is one demo or
  activity on your own campus each month.

 Responsibility 
 • Share your own referral links in class groups and on your social accounts, with an
  honest line on what the product actually did for you.
• Run one live demo a month on campus — a canteen or library desk-to-desk, a club
  session, or a fest stall.
• Post 4+ stories or posts a month using the content kit we give you.

• Funnel thinking — link, install, first use, purchase. You find your weakest step in
  your own numbers and fix it.
• Customer conversations — real objections, answered without overpromising.
• Reading your own data — form a theory, test it, report what happened.
• Marketing ethics — disclosure, consent and honest claims.
 Requirements 
 • 18+, currently enrolled at a college in India.
• An active Instagram account and access to your class WhatsApp groups.
• Willing to do one in-person demo a month on your own campus.
• Able to commit 5–6 hours a week for two months.
• No prior sales experience needed. We care more about your written answers than
  your follower count.

 Support partnership discussions and coordination in India and internationally.

 Identify potential clients, business opportunities and collaboration prospects.

 Support client engagement and business development activities.

 Understand how business development, partnerships, startup operations and go-to-market activities work in practice.

 Build professional relationships with industry leaders, investors, institutions and startup ecosystem partners across India and internationally.
 Strategic & Execution Skills:

 Understand how innovative ventures are developed, positioned, funded and scaled.

 Gain practical exposure that can help shape your future in entrepreneurship, business leadership, strategy or startup management.

 We are looking for individuals who are:
 Curious, energetic and enthusiastic about learning.
 Strong in communication

 Why do you want to join Cyber HX?

unstop-1780701.body:
About the Company 
 Insybit is building Oktivo, an AI-powered Revenue OS that helps businesses automate customer conversations, manage leads, and accelerate sales through AI Voice Agents, CRM, WhatsApp automation, and intelligent workflows. As an early-stage startup, we are creating technology that helps businesses sell smarter, respond faster, and scale customer engagement without scaling their teams. This role offers the opportunity to work hands-on with an ambitious B2B SaaS brand and contribute directly to its content and growth journey.
 Responsibilities 
 Research and create engaging content about AI, sales automation, CRM, conversational AI, startups, and emerging technology.
 Write blogs, LinkedIn posts, social media captions, newsletters, website copy, and educational resources.
 Turn product features, customer use cases, and founder insights into compelling content.
 Develop concepts for short-form videos, reels, carousels, and other social creatives.
 Use tools such as ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity, and Canva to accelerate content creation while maintaining originality and quality.
 Manage and grow Oktivo's presence across LinkedIn, Instagram, and other relevant platforms.
 Plan and execute weekly content calendars, identify trends, and support founder-led thought leadership.
 Conduct keyword research, create SEO-focused content, research competitors, and identify content gaps.
 Support organic lead generation through LinkedIn outreach, community engagement, directories, and relevant online platforms.
 Experiment with messaging, content distribution, and acquisition channels while tracking reach, engagement, website traffic, and leads.
 Requirements 
 Students or recent graduates in Marketing, Business, Communications, or a related field are welcome to apply.
 Strong English writing and communication skills, with the ability to simplify complex ideas.
 Genuine interest in AI, B2B SaaS, startups, technology, digital marketing, and content creation.
 Familiarity with LinkedIn, Instagram, and current digital content trends.
 Comfort using or learning AI and creative tools such as ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity, and Canva.
 Basic knowledge of SEO, content marketing, or growth marketing is an advantage.
 Self-motivated, resourceful, curious, and willing to take ownership of projects.
 We value creativity, curiosity, and execution more than degrees or certifications.
 During the internship, you will work directly with the founding team of an early-stage AI SaaS startup and gain practical exposure to AI, B2B SaaS marketing, content strategy, SEO, growth experiments, product launches, go-to-market initiatives, and customer acquisition. You will build a portfolio of published content and measurable growth projects, with an opportunity for a full-time role based on performance.
 Success in this role means building and executing a consistent content calendar, growing Oktivo's organic reach and engagement, publishing high-quality search-focused content, testing multiple distribution strategies, and contributing to relevant inbound interest and qualified leads.
 Application prompt: Share one creative idea you would implement to help Oktivo reach its first 1,000 potential business customers.

 Emporio Pet Care Services (OPC) Pvt. Ltd. is building practical, customer-focused services for pet parents and local communities. The team is looking for a Performance Marketing Intern who can help reach nearby customers efficiently through measurable digital campaigns.

 Set up and monitor click-to-WhatsApp advertisements.
 Track cost per customer by campaign every morning using spreadsheets.
 Pause campaigns that miss the agreed target and document performance observations.

 Requirements 
 Fresher pursuing or recently completing a marketing-related course.
 Hands-on exposure to at least one small Meta campaign; a certification or college project is acceptable.
 Basic familiarity with Meta Ads Manager, Google local campaigns, radius targeting, click-to-WhatsApp ads, and spreadsheets.
 Comfort with numbers, daily tracking, experimentation, and performance-focused decision-making.
 Strong ownership, attention to detail, and willingness to learn in a practical operating environment.
 This is a three-month, full-time, in-office internship based in Gurgaon with a monthly stipend of ₹3,000–₹7,000 and three openings. Freshers are welcome to apply.

unstop-1786946.body:
ExamLyft AI, owned by Havelock Consulting LLP, is an AI-powered exam preparation and assessment platform for coaching institutes. We are offering one paid sales trainee internship with guided learning and practical B2B sales experience.
 Compensation and schedule 
 ₹6,000 per month guaranteed stipend, independent of sales results.
 Additional commission: 5% of eligible subscription collections during each attributed institute’s first 12 months.
 Three-month internship; full-time, remote, 40 hours per week.
 Applications welcome from across India.
 Commission is settled monthly after the applicable refund window. Eligible collections exclude GST, refunds and credits and reflect discounts. Lead attribution, payout timing and treatment of pending leads will be agreed in writing before joining.
 What you will learn and do 
 Learn the platform and understand the institute customer.
 Research suitable institutes and identify decision-makers.
 Practise introductory outreach and qualify interest.
 Arrange product demos and follow up with interested institutes.
 Maintain lead notes and review progress with our team weekly.
 Who can apply 
 No prior sales experience or institute connections required.
 Clear communication, curiosity, initiative and reliable follow-through matter.
 You should be available for 40 hours per week during the internship.
 Support and selection 
 We provide product orientation, guidance on outreach, demo support and help with pricing discussions and onboarding. Selection includes an introductory conversation and a simulated sales discussion. No application fees or unpaid live prospecting assignments.
 Future employment is not guaranteed. Any extension depends on mutual fit and business needs.
